text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Only three liquid-sodium experiments have made their own field, each a different kind. In Riga, a corkscrew flow made a field that oscillates and slowly turns. In Karlsruhe, fifty-two spiralling cells made a steady field, close to a dipole. And only <|phoneme_start|>V IY1 K EY1 EH1 S<|phoneme_end|>, at Cadarache, made a dipole that can flip.
